content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: D. Pharm; Desirable: Knowledge in Computer Application; Eligible for training only if the date of commencement of training and the date of issue of last mark list is less than three years Experience: Candidates having more than one year training or job experience after attaining the qualification are not eligible Age limit: Maximum 30 years (as on 1 November 2026) Other conditions: Eligible for training only if the date of commencement of training and the date of issue of last mark list is less than three years. Desirable: Knowledge in Computer Application

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates having more than one year training or job experience after attaining the qualification Candidates whose last mark list was issued three years or more before the commencement of training

content_sections.text: Period of training: 1 year A panel will be prepared in addition to the 2 vacancies

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Apprentice Trainee in Pharmacy.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Achutha Menon Centre for Health Science Studies, Medical College Campus, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years (as on 1 November 2026).

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible for training only if the date of commencement of training and the date of issue of last mark list is less than three years.

faq.answer: Candidates having more than one year training or job experience after attaining the qualification. Candidates whose last mark list was issued three years or more before the commencement of training.
